runs.name: thyssenkrupp AG; Germany, Frankfurt and Duesseldorf TKA, not an SEC registrant (EDGAR holds only the ADR facility's F-6EF of 2011 and F-6 of 2014), Sponsored Level I OTC ADR one ADS to one share; five segments in FY2024/25, Automotive Technology, Decarbon Technologies, Materials Services, Steel Europe, Marine Systems; TKMS listed 2025-10-20 with 51% kept; EP Group's 20% of Steel Europe returned 2025-09-30; Jindal Steel International's indicative offer for Steel Europe, talks paused 2026-05-02; Automation Engineering sold 2025-11-21; HKM sold to Salzgitter; Materials Services 49% spin-off approved 2026-08-07; Reliance, Ryerson and Olympic Steel read from their 10-K facts as a CONVENTION of the run, Kloeckner flagged
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **EUR 13.825** a share (Xetra 2026-10-13; Yahoo chart via `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged; the ADR TKAMY **US$ 15.512**, OTC, Sponsored Level I, one ADS to one ordinary share per the depositary's Form F-6 of 2014-11-12, accession 0001193805-14-002141, re-read by the analyst). Shares **622,531,741**, one class, no treasury shares (Annual Report 2024/2025 p.18; the same count in the 9-month report 2025/2026, approved 2026-08-11, Note 15); cap **EUR 8,606.5M**. Sovereign **3.76%** (ECB YC.B.U2.EUR.4F.G_N_A.SV_C_YM.SR_30Y, 2026-10-12). Filings read, from the company: Annual Report 2024/2025 (management report authorized Essen 2025-11-26), Annual Reports 2016/17 to 2023/24, the Q1, H1 and 9-month interim reports 2025/2026, the corporate governance statement; the ad hoc page renders by script and was not read, the 9M report's subsequent-events note being the latest filed record used; one figure cross-checked (FY2024/25 operating cash flows EUR 1,684M in the cash flow statement against the multi-year overview). `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` not used (non-SEC filer); arithmetic by hand in `scripts/arith.py`. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's segment, economic-position and risk sections (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. **Q1 IN** on the deciding part, **Materials Services**, chosen on five-year segment EBIT after special items (EUR 1,858M of a group total of EUR (118)M, so the largest part, none carrying half) by a **CONVENTION of the run**, adjusted EBIT beside; on the filer's adjusted EBIT Steel Europe (EUR 2,233M of 4,768M) would decide instead, and the analyst records that reading as closing TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1 on the company's own refusal to write a steel margin target and its "no functioning hydrogen market"; the analyst says plainly that the box depends on the measure. **Q2 OUT**: a metals distributor with no pricing power and the high-cost operator of its field: segment EBIT margin **1.51%** over FY2016 to FY2025 (adjusted 2.11%) against Reliance 9.75%, Ryerson 4.44% and Olympic Steel 3.37% (2016 to 2024), the three rivals chosen as a CONVENTION of the run because the annual report names none, read from SEC companyfacts (transcription), Kloeckner & Co flagged as not an SEC filer and not read; management's own target, adjusted EBIT margin 2% to 3%, below every rival's decade margin; pre-tax return on capital 5.6% (EBIT) to 7.8% (adjusted) over ten years; a mix caveat (an international trading business lowers the margin on sales) written down by the analyst. Facts after the stop, not weighed: group ROCE 3.4%, 11.3%, (9.3)%, (8.0)%, 0.7% FY2021 to 2025 against the company's WACC of 8% to 11%; Steel Europe EUR 4.35bn capex against 0.97bn depreciation and EUR 4.1bn of impairments over five years; special items every year, adjusted EBIT named first among the financial indicators, FY2025 net income including EUR 902M of non-cash TK Elevator fair-value income; a 10% capital increase at EUR 24.30 in September 2017, no buybacks, a EUR 0.15 dividend paid FY2022 to FY2025 while owner cash was negative; the Krupp Foundation about 21%; TKMS 49% listed October 2025, Materials Services (tk accelis) 49% spin-off approved 2026-08-07. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: annual segment guidance revised within the year and reported "achieved" against the cut forecast, the adjusted figure featured; the compensation report not read. Owner cash (operating cash flows less PP&E and intangible capex, plus direct-reduction grants, less lease principal and minority dividends) EUR **(393)M** a year equity-only and **(395)M** all-equity over FY2021 to 2025; the depreciation variant EUR 143M all-equity, shown and not used (depreciation lowered by the impairments); the company's own free cash flow before M&A negative in six of nine years FY2017 to 2025, and EUR (1,940)M in the nine months to June 2026. Balance sheets FY2016 to June 2026: equity 6% to 10% of assets FY2016 to 2019 with an accumulated deficit to EUR (6.9)bn, rebuilt by the FY2020 Elevator sale, EUR 14.7bn peak FY2022, EUR 10.9bn at June 2026; net financial assets EUR 4.9bn to 2.6bn in nine months; pension provisions EUR 5.0bn above the net cash; inventory days 58 to 67 before, 72 to 82 after; ratings BB and Ba3. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value **EUR (13.15)** a share all-equity, the no-growth case alone (owner cash changes sign), all spending central, plus net cash EUR 2,321M (June 2026 net financial assets EUR 2,621M less the HKM equity contribution taken at EUR 300M, the midpoint of a filed range, a CONVENTION of the run; pensions left out as Q7's basis says, said so); equity-only EUR (16.79), the depreciation variant EUR 9.83 beside; fair **EUR (2.62)** all-equity, **EUR (6.31)** equity-only, the same per ADS, the depreciation variant EUR 6.02 beside and not central, not armed, the box being OUT at Q2; no case earns the floor at the price (central (6.3)%, depreciation variant 2.3%). Contamination declared by the analyst: the SZGPY commit subjects in its opening git status (a steel name, its box and figures), other names' untracked research-file names (AYI, ARCB), memory-index lines on the queue; none opened or used, the box resting on a different part and question; nothing about thyssenkrupp seen. Foundations and standing rule committed with Q1, not separately. Commits 2a665b4d, f95970f7, 50d19f39. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `scripts/check_cites.py` clean (39 ids, 32 fragments); the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 39 ids, 32 quoted cites, no missing id, no E-id, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the parts test names no measure of operating profit, and here the measure decides the box (segment EBIT: Materials Services, OUT at Q2; adjusted EBIT: Steel Europe, TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1); (2) when the group's five-year operating profit is negative every profitable part carries "more than half", and a loss-making part with large liabilities (Steel Europe's pensions, restructuring, the HKM contribution) is invisible to the threshold; (3) no instruction for a parent selling minority stakes in every segment, whose future statements describe a different perimeter; (4) Q7 with a negative base reports a negative fair price where "no fair price above zero" would say the same; (5) Q7's net debt leaves out pensions, here larger than the net cash. Could not get: the ad hoc releases after August 2026, the compensation report, ArcelorMittal and Salzgitter for the steel part, Olympic Steel FY2025, the rivals' returns on capital.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT on the deciding part, Materials Services (chosen on five-year segment EBIT, EUR 1,858M against a group total of EUR (118)M, a CONVENTION of the run; on adjusted EBIT Steel Europe would decide and the analyst reads that as TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1): a metals distributor with no pricing power, 1.51% EBIT margin over FY2016 to 2025 against Reliance 9.75%, Ryerson 4.44%, Olympic Steel 3.37%, its own 2% to 3% target below every rival's decade; 5.6% to 7.8% pre-tax on capital. Owner cash EUR (395)M a year all-equity over FY2021 to 2025, company free cash flow negative in six of nine years. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value EUR (13.15) (no-growth case alone) against EUR 13.825, fair EUR (2.62) all-equity, EUR (6.31) equity-only, not armed. Integrity facts recorded, not judged (guidance cut then reported achieved, adjusted EBIT featured). Framework gaps for the operator: no profit measure in the parts test, deciding the box here; the half threshold when the group total is negative; a parent mid-split; a negative Q7 base; pensions outside net debt.
